title: Duplicate Supplier Reservation Generated Under Ambiguous Timeout
cwe: CWE-675: Multiple Operations on Resource / CWE-841: Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow
technical_description: The agency initiated a booking for intent INTENT-DEMO-VULN-001. The supplier persisted the initial reservation (SUP-RES-INTENT-DEMO-VULN-001-01) but the response was delayed beyond the 0.15s aggregator HTTP timeout. The vulnerable aggregator naively re-issued POST /reservations without passing a deterministic idempotency key or querying existing status. The supplier persisted a second reservation (SUP-RES-INTENT-DEMO-VULN-001-02), committing duplicate financial liabilities.
remediation_guidance:
1. Enforce capability-aware dispatching: pass a deterministic idempotency key on all mutating requests.
2. On ambiguous timeout, invoke supplier reference lookup or safe idempotent replay.
3. If the supplier lacks idempotency (NEITHER capability), escalate to RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED rather than blindly retrying.

retest_result.summary: Fixed mode reconciled ambiguous timeout via idempotency contract. Exactly 1 reservation (SUP-RES-INTENT-DEMO-FIXED-001-01) committed in supplier DB. Invariant 5.2 passed.

title: Duplicate Financial Ledger Entries and Entitlement Overflow via Webhook Replay
cwe: CWE-675: Multiple Operations on Resource / CWE-799: Improper Control of Interaction Frequency
violated_invariant: INV-5.3: Webhook Idempotency & INV-5.5: Refund Boundedness
expected_outcome: Single refund effect (5,000 INR) with total refund <= 12000.0 INR
actual_outcome: 3 duplicate ledger entries created totaling 15000.0 INR. Excess over entitlement: 3000.0 INR.
technical_description: The payment provider delivered webhook event 'evt_demo_wh_vuln_replay' 3 times. In vulnerable mode, the aggregator processed each delivery as a distinct refund, creating 3 separate ledger credit entries and disbursing 15000.0 INR, which exceeded the maximum allowable refund entitlement (12000.0 INR) by 3000.0 INR.
remediation_guidance:
1. Enforce atomic idempotency locks on incoming webhook event IDs.
2. Record processed event IDs in an immutable deduplication store before applying financial ledger mutations.
3. Reject duplicate deliveries with HTTP 200 (idempotent no-op) without re-executing accounting transfers.

retest_result.summary: Fixed mode deduplicated repeated webhook deliveries. Exactly 1 refund (5,000 INR) applied across 3 deliveries. Invariants 5.3 & 5.4 passed.
